name: Spreadsheet Viewer
description: View Excel and OpenDocument spreadsheets in Orca's editor: every sheet, formulas and formatted values, even for very large files.

cover.alt: A quarterly summary workbook in Spreadsheet Viewer: formatted currency, percentages and dates, a SUM formula above the grid, and sheet tabs

screenshots.alt: A 50,000-row data sheet with a block of cells selected and its count, sum and average in the status bar
screenshots.caption: Large sheets scroll smoothly

screenshots.alt: The same summary workbook in Orca's dark theme, with merged title and notes cells and a #DIV/0! error in red
screenshots.caption: Follows Orca's dark theme
